# Studio strategy: build our own capabilities (adopted 2026-11-13)

**No paid AI generation. No subscriptions. No heavyweight local models.** Claude acts as creative director, programmer, animator, editor and production engineer; every image and sound is generated by code in this repo using free, open-source tools that fit an 8 GB M1 with limited disk.

## Technology research — what we chose and why
| Need | Choice | Licence | Footprint | Why / alternatives considered |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Programmatic video | **Remotion 4** | Remotion licence (free ≤3-person co.) | ~125 MB + 470 MB headless Chrome | React timeline, frame-exact, renders WebGL on the GPU. |
| HTML/GSAP motion | **HyperFrames 0.9** | Apache-2.0 | 36 MB | Best-in-class `check` QC; global skills. |
| 3D | **Three.js 0.187** + R3F + @remotion/three | MIT | ~25 MB | PBR (transmission, clearcoat), post-processing, glTF. Runs inside Remotion deterministically. |
| Shaders | **GLSL** via Three.js | — | 0 | Raymarched worlds, liquids, gradients — infinite worlds for zero assets. |
| Animation | **GSAP 3.15** (+SplitText, MorphSVG now free) | GSAP Standard no-charge licence (commercial OK; not for building a competing visual web builder) | 6 MB | Industry-standard eases/timelines; bridged into Remotion via seek. |
| SVG morphing | **flubber** | MIT | 88 KB | Robust point-matching between arbitrary paths. |
| Voice | **Piper TTS 1.8** | GPL-3.0 (tool only; generated audio is ours) | 34 MB + ~60 MB/voice | Fast, offline, good quality. Kokoro-82M (Apache) is the upgrade path if more expressiveness is needed (~90–300 MB). |
| Transcription | **faster-whisper small** | MIT | ~460 MB model | Offline, word timestamps; script-aligned captions fix any mishearing. |
| Music & SFX | **In-house synth.py / sfx.py** (numpy/scipy) | ours | 0 | Original, royalty-free, deterministic, emits exact beat maps for sync. MusicGen/torch rejected (GBs, RAM). |
| Editing/encoding | **FFmpeg 9** | LGPL/GPL | system | Cuts, loudness, LUTs, delivery. |
| 3D production DCC | **Blender** (optional) | GPL | ~1.2 GB app | Not installed yet (disk, and it installs outside the project). Three.js covers current needs; Blender would add cloth/fluid/rigid-body sims and Cycles path tracing. Needs user approval. |

## Capability → implementation
| Capability | Implementation | Skill |
|---|---|---|
| Procedural 3D animation, 3D product visualization | `ProductStage`, `LiquidChrome` | studio-3d-threejs |
| Cinematic camera systems | Rig components (orbit/dist/height/lookY), `CameraRig`, shader cameras (`uDolly`, `uRise`) | studio-cinematographer, studio-3d-threejs |
| Product advertising | ProductStage + callouts + lockup (reel scene D) | studio-3d-threejs, studio-kinetic-typography |
| Liquid simulations (look) & particle effects | noise-displaced liquid metal, `LIQUID_GRADIENT`, `ParticleMorph` (24k GPU particles, curl noise) | studio-glsl-shaders, studio-particles |
| Morphing transitions | `MorphShape`, `MorphPath`, flash/zoom/whip transitions | studio-morph-transitions |
| Parallax and depth | `Parallax`, `CameraRig`, fog/DoF in shaders | studio-motion-designer |
| Kinetic typography | `KineticText`, `useGsapTimeline` + SplitText | studio-kinetic-typography |
| Surreal environments | `SURREAL_WORLD` raymarcher | studio-glsl-shaders |
| Film-style lighting & compositing | three-point + environment, rim sweeps, ACES, bloom, `FilmLook` (grain, vignette, 2.39 letterbox) | studio-cinematographer |
| Music synchronization | spec-driven synth with exact beat map → scenes on sections, flashes on impacts, `beatPulse` | studio-procedural-audio |

## Honest limits
Procedural ≠ photoreal people. We cannot generate realistic humans, real locations or live-action plates; for those, use the client's own footage (fully supported by the editing pipeline). True fluid/cloth simulation would need Blender. Synth music is electronic/cinematic in character.
